description: Etat du parc des bus de la SORETRAS is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Société régionale de transport de Sfax (SORETRAS). Ce jeu de données classifie les bus de SORETRAS par catégorie et précise le nombre de bus pour chaque type de véhicule. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Société régionale de transport de Sfax (SORETRAS). It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OTL (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
